title: The Ces\`aro average criterion on infinite utility streams and its extensions
abstract: arXiv:2502.04934v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When evaluating policies that affect future generations, the most commonly used criterion is the discounted utilitarian rule. However, in terms of intergenerational fairness, it is difficult to justify prioritizing the current generation over future generations. This paper axiomatically examines impartial utilitarian rules over infinite-dimensional utility streams. We provide simple characterizations of the social welfare ordering that evaluates utility streams by their long-run average on the domain where the average exists. Furthermore, we derive the necessary and sufficient conditions for the same axioms to hold in a more general domain, the set of bounded utility streams. Some of these results are closely related to the Banach limits, a well-known generalization of the classical limit concept for streams. Thus, this paper can be seen as proposing an appealing subclass of Banach limits through axiomatic analysis.

translated_title: 无限效用流上的切萨罗平均准则及其扩展
translated_abstract: 在评估影响子孙后代的政策时，最常用的准则是贴现功利主义规则。然而，从代际公平的角度来看，优先考虑当代人而忽视后代人的做法难以自圆其说。本文在公理化框架下研究了无限维效用流上的无偏见功利主义规则。我们在平均值存在的定义域上，给出了通过长期平均值来评估效用流的社会福利排序的简单刻画。此外，我们在更一般的定义域——有界效用流集合上，推导出了相同公理成立的充分必要条件。其中一些结果与巴拿赫极限密切相关，巴拿赫极限是序列经典极限概念的一个著名推广。因此，本文可以被视为通过公理化分析提出了巴拿赫极限的一个具有吸引力的子类。
tldr: 本文公理化刻画了基于长期平均值（切萨罗平均）评估无限效用流的无偏见功利主义社会福利排序，并在有界效用流上给出了相应公理成立的充要条件，从而提出了巴拿赫极限的一个具有吸引力的子类。
en_tdlr: This paper axiomatically characterizes impartial utilitarian social welfare orderings that evaluate infinite utility streams by their long-run (Cesàro) average, and derives necessary and sufficient conditions for the same axioms on the domain of bounded utility streams, thereby proposing an appealing subclass of Banach limits.
